content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?SLIMS Hospital Puducherry's PostSLIMS Hospital PuducherryJune 28, 2024 · Shared with Public Understanding Alzheimer's Disease Did you know that memory loss, confusion, and difficulty in completing familiar tasks can be early signs of Alzheimer's disease? Age, family history, and genetics are major risk factors, but lifestyle choices like diet, exercise, and mental activity also play a crucial role. Consult our Neurologist if any of the above symptoms are noted in the elders of your family. Early detection can make a significant difference.
